explanation_short: The incremental feature analysis table shows that adding more features generally improves model performance, particularly for RF and KNN, as evidenced by increasing R² values.
explanation_full: The incremental feature analysis table demonstrates how model performance metrics, such as R² and MSE, change as more features are added sequentially. For instance, the R² score for RF increases from 0.4026 (with only VFA) to 0.7855 (with all 11 features). Similarly, KNN's R² improves from 0.6448 to 0.8178. This trend suggests that incorporating additional, relevant features significantly enhances the predictive power of the models, with the best performance achieved when all 11 features are included.
